verdict.rationale: Opting out of model training is a fair privacy question for an AI assistant and API platform, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence pack documents a training opt-out, a data-usage control, or a no-training policy for Kimi or the Kimi API. The project-level budgets, IP whitelists and audit logs are adjacent controls and earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
